vocabulary.meaning_en: having a lot of work to do; not free

vocabulary.meaning_en: the work you do to get money
vocabulary.example: She has a new job at a bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the day before today

vocabulary.meaning_en: this day

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say you are sorry

vocabulary.note_en: apologize for something. Noun: apology. UK spelling: apologise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with

vocabulary.meaning_en: the early part of the day, before 12 noon

vocabulary.meaning_en: the time from about 6 p.m. until night
vocabulary.example: He reads in the evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used after a time to mean before 12 noon
vocabulary.example: The class starts at 9 a.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used after a time to mean after 12 noon
vocabulary.example: The meeting is at 5 p.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at a time after now
vocabulary.example: I'll call you later.

vocabulary.meaning_en: possibly; perhaps
vocabulary.note_en: It usually comes at the start of a sentence.
vocabulary.example: Maybe I'll see you tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room where people make and record TV or radio shows
vocabulary.example: The news show is in studio 3.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put sound or pictures on a tape, phone or computer
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل: reCORD (النبرة على المقطع الثاني)، والاسم: REcord.
vocabulary.example: They are recording a show now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a program on TV or radio
vocabulary.example: Her morning show is very popular.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room where a person works at a desk
vocabulary.example: Please come to my office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when people meet to eat and have fun together
vocabulary.example: We have a party for our new co-worker.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you did not expect
vocabulary.note_ar: يقولها الناس بصوت عالٍ في حفلة مفاجئة: Surprise!
vocabulary.note_en: People shout "Surprise!" at a surprise party.
vocabulary.example: The gift was a big surprise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: continuing until now
vocabulary.example: I still have my old phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; great (informal)
vocabulary.note_ar: كلمة عامية شائعة جدًا في أمريكا.
vocabulary.note_en: Informal, very common in American English.
vocabulary.example: This cake is awesome!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sound that shows you feel relieved, tired or hot
vocabulary.meaning_ar: صوت يعبّر عن الارتياح أو التعب (يا للراحة!)
vocabulary.example: Phew! The test is finished.

vocabulary.meaning_en: on all days
vocabulary.note_ar: every day (كلمتان) = كل يوم، أما everyday (كلمة واحدة) فصفة بمعنى «يومي».
vocabulary.note_en: every day (two words) = each day; everyday (one word) = normal, daily.
vocabulary.example: I walk to work every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that gives light, like a lamp
vocabulary.example: When the red light is on, be quiet.

fine_lines.title: a.m. vs p.m.
fine_lines.explanation_ar: a.m. للوقت من منتصف الليل حتى الظهر، و p.m. للوقت من الظهر حتى منتصف الليل. نضعهما بعد الرقم فقط، ولا نقول «in the morning» معها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: a.m. is from midnight to 12 noon. p.m. is from 12 noon to midnight. Put them after the number. Don't add "in the morning" too.

fine_lines.title: morning / afternoon / evening
fine_lines.explanation_ar: morning من الصباح حتى الظهر، afternoon من الظهر حتى نحو السادسة، evening من السادسة حتى وقت النوم. نقول: in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening، لكن at night.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Morning is before noon, afternoon is from noon to about 6, evening is from about 6 to bedtime. Say in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening, but at night.

examples.sentence: I have a class this afternoon.
We watch the news in the evening.

expressions.meaning_en: Do you have time now, or are you working?

expressions.example: I'm a little busy. Can we talk later?

expressions.meaning_en: I apologize for what happened yesterday.
expressions.example: Sorry about yesterday. I was very tired.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to ask for permission.
expressions.example: May I see your new office?
I can't come today. Maybe another time.

expressions.meaning_en: At this moment I have work.
expressions.example: Right now I am busy, sorry.

expressions.meaning_en: Visit me for a short time this afternoon.
expressions.example: I have the book. Come by this afternoon.

expressions.meaning_en: Forget the bad things; start again today.
expressions.example: Yesterday was bad, but today is a new day!
Thanks for watching. Until next time!

grammar.title: Telling the time with at
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) لنسأل عن الوقت نقول: What time is it?
٢) نذكر الساعة ثم الدقائق: 5:00 = five o'clock، 10:30 = ten thirty.
٣) نضيف a.m. للصباح و p.m. لبعد الظهر والمساء.
٤) نستخدم at قبل وقت محدد: at 10 a.m.، at 5 p.m.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Ask: What time is it?
2) Say the hour, then the minutes: 5:00 = five o'clock, 10:30 = ten thirty.
3) Add a.m. (morning) or p.m. (afternoon/evening).
4) Use at before an exact time: at 10 a.m., at 5 p.m.
examples: What time is it? It's nine o'clock.
Come to my office at 5:00 p.m.

grammar.title: Yes/No questions with be: Are you busy?
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) لنصنع سؤالًا بنعم أو لا مع فعل be نضع am / is / are قبل الفاعل: You are busy → Are you busy?
٢) الإجابة القصيرة: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
٣) مع he/she/it نستخدم is: Is she busy? Yes, she is.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) To make a yes/no question with be, put am / is / are before the subject: You are busy → Are you busy?
2) Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
3) With he/she/it use is: Is she busy? Yes, she is.
examples: Are you busy? Yes, I am.
Is he at work? No, he isn't.
Are they in the studio? Yes, they are.

grammar.title: Present continuous for actions happening now
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم am / is / are + الفعل مع ing لحدث يجري الآن.
٢) I am writing (أنا أكتب الآن).
٣) نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات: Every day I do my morning show.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Use am / is / are + verb-ing for an action happening now.
2) I am writing. He is recording.
3) Use the simple present for habits: Every day I do my morning show.
examples: Right now I am writing a report.
Every day she reads the news.

questions.question: What does "busy" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: busy تعني مشغولًا لديه عمل كثير.
questions.explanation_en: Busy means you have a lot to do and are not free.

questions.question: Choose the correct question: ___ you busy?
questions.explanation_ar: مع you نستخدم are: Are you busy?
questions.explanation_en: With you we use are: Are you busy?

questions.question: The meeting is at 5:00 ___. (in the afternoon)
questions.explanation_en: p.m. is for times after 12 noon.

questions.question: "Sorry about yesterday." "___"
questions.explanation_ar: No worries تعني لا بأس، وهي رد مناسب على الاعتذار.

questions.question: What does "apologize" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: apologize يعني يعتذر، أي يقول إنه آسف.
questions.explanation_en: To apologize is to say you are sorry.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع المستمر: am + الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: "Are you busy?" "No, ___."
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة القصيرة بالنفي: No, I'm not.
questions.explanation_en: The short negative answer is: No, I'm not.

questions.question: Which word means "the day before today"?
questions.explanation_en: Yesterday is the day before today.

questions.question: Come by this ___. (between 12 and 6)

questions.explanation_en: Afternoon is from noon until about 6.

questions.question: Your co-workers have a party for you, and you did not expect it. They shout:
questions.explanation_ar: Surprise! تعني مفاجأة، تُقال في الحفلة المفاجئة.
questions.explanation_en: People shout "Surprise!" at a surprise party.
